subject: Invitation to our Annual Charity Gala
body: Dear valued supporter, We are pleased to invite you to our Annual Charity Gala on November 15th. The event will feature a silent auction, live music, and a gourmet dinner. Your attendance and support are crucial to our mission of helping those in need. Please RSVP by November 5th to secure your spot. We look forward to seeing you there! Sincerely, The Charity Foundation Team
